answer: Attacker forks a plume of fake keys but pays real energy per identity, while honest peers verify a lightweight raven-signed registry. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity: each agent must burn compute to mint a unique keypair, cost scaling with network size so one extra identity yields no voting advantage. Like a reef accreting slowly, identity grows expensive to fake but cheap to check. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
